Threatened miscarriage is a common complica- tion of pregnancy that presents before 20 weeks of gestation as vaginal bleeding, with or without abdominal pain, while the cer- vix is closed and the fetus is viable. Endogenous progesterone is normally produced by the corpus luteum to maintain pregnancy, and low concentrations have been associated with pregnancy loss.
